title: Orchestral plan for DX initiatives: signal matrix and surge resourcing
creator: Lina Martinez
description: Create an orchestration plan that aligns SDK, docs, and quickstart initiatives to OKRs and upcoming cycles. Deliverables: a signal matrix (which signal maps to which initiative and experiment), a prioritized surge resourcing plan for bursts of engineering/design support, and a lightweight cadence template for cross-team syncs. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, and Design trade-offs to maximize developer activation while containing scope creep.
success_metrics: Increase SDK consumer activation by 12% quarter-over-quarter
Reduce time-to-first-success for quickstart flows from 18m to 8m
Achieve 90% on-time delivery for prioritized docs/SDK tasks in the surge window
acceptance_criteria: Signal matrix published in Confluence with owner and ingestion source for each signal
Surge staffing plan finalized with named owners and backup rotations
Rollout calendar (milestone-level) synced to product and engineering calendars
Operational playbook for runbook + post-mortem created for the surge period
Stakeholder sign-off from Eng leads, Head of DX, and Legal (if needed)
tasks: Workshop 1: Map signals to initiatives (PM, Eng, Design) - Jan 15
Draft surge staffing model and cost envelope - Jan 21
Design backlog triage and quick wins list - Jan 28
Create rollout calendar and publish to shared calendar - Feb 3
Implement two pilot experiment templates for SDK telemetry - Feb 10
Finalize playbook and escalation path - Feb 12
notes_and_decisions: Decision (2025-01-17): Prioritize SDK streaming quickstart over non-streaming SDKs for Q1 based on activation delta per effort estimate
Trade-off: Accept a narrower platform surface (fewer languages) for the surge to deliver deeper DX for top 3 languages
Fallback policy: If Eng capacity < 60% during surge, shift remaining items to Q2 backlog and run focused docs-only experiments

followups: Create a reusable experiment template for quickstarts to standardize measurement
Run a retrospective within 2 weeks of surge completion and publish learnings
Convert top 3 quick wins into grooming tickets for next sprint cycle
